title: Where a failed Task state goes next
heading: Step Functions Waits for the Job and Catches What the Worker Cannot
cases: a retried error then a success, and an error sent straight to its catcher
two errors of one retrier's list use its two attempts; the third goes to a catcher
a retrier without MaxAttempts retries three times
attempts are counted per retrier, not across the state
once the first matching retrier is used up, a later matching retrier is not tried
States.TaskFailed catches any error except States.Timeout
MaxAttempts 0 means the error is never retried
